content.short: Palmera provides multisig smart account infrastructure for organisations running many Safes.
content.description: Palmera builds and operates production multisig infrastructure on EVM chains, based on Safe smart accounts. It handles deterministic deployment of the Safe contracts on a new network, then activates the indexing and backend services those accounts need to function. Ecosystems can also take a white-label Safe-compatible interface with continuous maintenance included. Several networks use it to provide multisig support to their users, Hyperliquid among them.
